# Sierra Fish & Pets

> Family-owned and operated independent pet store, freshwater and marine aquarium center, and pet nutrition supply retailer in Renton, Washington. Serving Renton, Seattle, Bellevue, Kent, SeaTac, Newcastle, and the greater Puget Sound area for over 50 years.

## Overview
Sierra Fish & Pets is the Pacific Northwest's premier destination for freshwater & saltwater aquarium fish, captive-bred reptiles, hand-fed birds, small animals, premium dog and cat nutrition, and professional aquarium installation & maintenance services.

- **Address:** 601 S Grady Way Suite M, Renton, WA 98057
- **Phone:** 425-226-3215
- **Email:** info@sierrafishandpets.com
- **Website:** https://sierrafishandpets.com
- **Operating Hours:**
  - Monday – Saturday: 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM
  - Sunday: 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM

---

## Core Product Categories & Live Animals
- [Shop All Products](https://sierrafishandpets.com/shop): Full catalog of pet food, supplies, and accessories.
- [Dog Supplies](https://sierrafishandpets.com/shop/dog): Premium dry kibble, wet food, raw diets, healthy treats, crates, leashes, harnesses, and durable toys.
- [Cat Supplies](https://sierrafishandpets.com/shop/cat): Natural grain-free foods, litters, scratching posts, cat trees, carrier crates, and interactive toys.
- [Aquatic & Fish Supplies](https://sierrafishandpets.com/shop/aquatic): Aquariums, LED lighting, canister & power filters, protein skimmers, heaters, substrates, water conditioners, and fish foods.
- [Reptile Supplies](https://sierrafishandpets.com/shop/reptile): Terrariums, UVB & heat lighting, substrates, live & frozen feeders, vitamins, and habitat décor.
- [Bird Supplies](https://sierrafishandpets.com/shop/bird): Nutritious seed & pellet diets, spacious cages, natural perches, foraging toys, and wing trimming accessories.
- [Small Animal Supplies](https://sierrafishandpets.com/shop/small-pet): Food, timothy hay, bedding, cages, exercise wheels, and treats for rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters, gerbils, and chinchillas.

## Weekly Live Animal Arrivals
- [New Bird Arrivals](https://sierrafishandpets.com/arrivals/birds): Parrots, finches, canaries, and hand-fed companion birds.
- [New Freshwater Fish Arrivals](https://sierrafishandpets.com/arrivals/freshwater): Tropical community fish, African & South American cichlids, discus, tetras, bettas, and live plants.
- [New Saltwater Fish Arrivals](https://sierrafishandpets.com/arrivals/saltwater): Marine fish, tangs, clownfish, invertebrates, live coral frags, and anemones.
- [New Reptile Arrivals](https://sierrafishandpets.com/arrivals/reptiles): Captive-bred geckos, bearded dragons, chameleons, snakes, and tortoises.
- [New Small Animal Arrivals](https://sierrafishandpets.com/arrivals/small-animals): Bunnies, guinea pigs, hamsters, rats, and pocket pets.
- [New Cat Arrivals & Essentials](https://sierrafishandpets.com/arrivals/cats): New feline product arrivals, kitten care items, and adoption partner updates.

## Professional Services
- [All Services](https://sierrafishandpets.com/services): Overview of in-store and on-site professional services.
- [Aqua Jet Water Cleaning System](https://sierrafishandpets.com/about-aqua-jet-water-cleaning-system): Effortless faucet-connected gravel vacuum and water changing system for home & commercial aquariums.
- [Aquarium Consulting & Design](https://sierrafishandpets.com/services/aquarium/aquarium-consulting-design): Custom aquascape design, livestock compatibility planning, and equipment consultation for homes and offices.
- [Custom Aquarium Builds](https://sierrafishandpets.com/services/aquarium/custom-aquariums): Custom glass and acrylic aquariums from nano setups to 500+ gallon luxury installations with custom cabinetry.
- [Aquarium Installation](https://sierrafishandpets.com/services/aquarium/aquarium-installation): Full delivery, setup, aquascaping, tank cycling, and initial fish acclimation.
- [Free Liquid Water Testing](https://sierrafishandpets.com/services/in-store/aquarium-water-testing): Professional in-store analysis of ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, pH, GH/KH, and marine salinity.
- [Fish of the Month Club](https://sierrafishandpets.com/services/in-store/fish-of-month-club): Free educational club for young hobbyists aged 10 and under with monthly punchcard rewards.
- [Special Order Animals](https://sierrafishandpets.com/special-order-animals): Source rare and specific livestock species through certified ethical breeders and wholesalers.

## Sierra Edu: Pet Care Guides & Educational Resources
- [Sierra Edu Hub](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education): Comprehensive pet care library for new and experienced pet owners.
- [Puppy Care Basics](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/puppy-care-basics): Essential guidance on puppy feeding, crate training, housebreaking, and early veterinary wellness.
- [Cat Care Guide](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/cat-care): Nutrition, litter box management, indoor enrichment, and preventative health for cats.
- [Setting Up a Freshwater Aquarium](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/setting-up-a-fw-aquarium): Step-by-step setup guide covering equipment, water conditioning, and nitrogen cycle initiation.
- [FW Aquarium Checklist](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/fw-aquarium-checklist): Complete equipment and maintenance checklist for freshwater aquarists.
- [Freshwater Fish Care](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/fw-care): Water parameter management, disease prevention, and compatible schooling community species.
- [Goldfish Care Guide](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/goldfish-in-a-fishbowl): Why filtered, spacious tanks are essential for goldfish longevity over small bowls.
- [Betta Fish Care](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/betta-fish-care): Tank sizing, gentle filtration, temperature management, and proper feeding for Betta splendens.
- [Aquarium Water Change Guide](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/aquarium-water-change): Step-by-step instructions for weekly partial water changes and gravel vacuuming.
- [Live Plant Care](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/live-plant-care): Substrate selection, LED spectrum lighting, liquid fertilizers, and root tabs for planted tanks.
- [Axolotl Care](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/axolotl-care): Cold-water parameters, bare-bottom or fine sand setup, and diet for Mexican walking fish (*Ambystoma mexicanum*).
- [Purchasing & Keeping Reptiles](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/purchasing-reptiles): Terrarium sizing, temperature gradients, humidity, and UVB lighting requirements.
- [Basic Bird Care](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/basic-bird-care): Cage placement, mental stimulation, balanced nutrition, and safe grooming.
- [Bird Foods to Avoid](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/bird-foods-to-avoid): Toxic food warnings (avocado, chocolate, caffeine, fruit seeds) and healthy alternatives.
- [Bird Training Guide](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/bird-training): Positive reinforcement, step-up commands, and trust-building techniques.
- [Chinchilla Care](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/chinchilla-care): Dust bath regimens, temperature control (under 75°F), and unlimited timothy hay nutrition.
- [Gerbil Care](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/gerbil-care): Deep burrowing bedding, chewing toys, and low-humidity housing.
- [Guinea Pig Care](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/guinea-pig-care): Daily dietary Vitamin C requirements, spacious enclosures, and social companionship.
- [Hamster Care](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/hamster-care): Appropriate wheel diameters, deep burrowing substrate, and seed mix enrichment.
- [Rat Care](https://sierrafishandpets.com/education/rat-care): Multi-level cage setups, intellectual stimulation, hammock beds, and social rat care.
